# Ageason

> Free age and date calculators in English, Arabic, Japanese and for the Nepali (Bikram Sambat) calendar. All calculations run in the browser.

## Calculators

- [Age Calculator by Date of Birth (DOB): Age on Specific Date](https://www.ageason.com/): Free online age calculator by date of birth (DOB). Calculate your exact age today or on any specific date/year in years, months, days, and total hours lived.
- [Altersrechner: Wie alt bin ich, Geburtstag und Sternzeichen](https://www.ageason.com/de/): Alter berechnen: Ihr genaues Alter in Jahren, Monaten, Tagen und Stunden, die Tage bis zum nächsten Geburtstag und Ihr Sternzeichen.
- [Kalkulator Umur: Hitung Usia dan Hari Ulang Tahun Berikutnya](https://www.ageason.com/id/): Kalkulator umur gratis: hitung umur Anda dalam tahun, bulan, hari dan jam, lihat zodiak dan hitung mundur ke ulang tahun berikutnya.
- [만 나이 계산기: 법적 만 나이와 연 나이 및 세는나이 계산](https://www.ageason.com/ko/): 만 나이 계산기: 생년월일로 법적 만 나이, 연 나이, 세는나이와 띠를 계산하고 다음 생일 디데이와 태어난 지 며칠인지 확인하세요.
- [Calculadora de Idade: Quantos Anos Eu Tenho e Próximo Aniversário](https://www.ageason.com/pt/): Calcular idade online: descubra quantos anos você tem em anos, meses e dias, quantos dias já viveu, seu signo e quanto falta para o aniversário.
- [Yaş Hesaplama: Kaç Yaşındayım, Doğum Günü ve Yaş Hesaplayıcı](https://www.ageason.com/tr/): Doğum tarihinize göre tam yaşınızı yıl, ay, gün ve saat olarak hesaplayın. Bir sonraki doğum gününüze kalan süreyi ve burcunuzu öğrenin.
- [التقويم الهجري: تقويم أم القرى لعام 1448 هـ](https://www.ageason.com/ar/calendar/): التقويم الهجري الشامل بتقويم أم القرى مع ما يقابله بالميلادي وجدول أشهر السنة الهجرية.
- [كم باقي على رمضان: العداد التنازلي لرمضان 1448](https://www.ageason.com/ar/ramadan/): العداد التنازلي الدقيق لمعرفة كم يوم وساعة باقي على بداية شهر رمضان المبارك 1448 هـ فلكيا وتقويم أم القرى.
- [التاريخ الهجري اليوم: تاريخ اليوم بالهجري والميلادي](https://www.ageason.com/ar/today/): اعرف تاريخ اليوم بالتقويمين الهجري (أم القرى) والميلادي بدقة مع اسم اليوم باللغة العربية والمناسبات الإسلامية القادمة.
- [حساب العمر بالهجري والميلادي | حاسبة العمر الدقيقة](https://www.ageason.com/ar/): حساب العمر من تاريخ الميلاد بالهجري والميلادي: اكتشف كم عمرك بالسنوات والأشهر والأيام، واحسب عمرك بالأيام، واعرف كم باقي على عيد ميلادي القادم.
- [Birth Year & Age by Year Calculator: What Year Was I Born?](https://www.ageason.com/birth-year-calculator/): Calculate your birth year from age or find your exact age in any calendar year. Free online age-by-year calculator with total days alive and life milestones.
- [Date Calculator: Add or Subtract Days from Any Date](https://www.ageason.com/date-calculator/): Add or subtract days, weeks, months, years or business days from any date. Instantly find the target calendar date and weekday.
- [Days Between Dates: Calculate Days Between Two Dates](https://www.ageason.com/days-between-dates/): Calculate the exact number of days, weeks, months and business days between two dates. Free, instant and private in your browser.
- [Datumsrechner und Tagerechner: Tage zwischen zwei Daten berechnen](https://www.ageason.com/de/datumsrechner/): Tagerechner: Tage zwischen zwei Daten zählen, Arbeitstage ohne Wochenenden berechnen oder Tage zu einem Datum addieren und subtrahieren.
- [Experience Calculator: Total Work Experience in Years, Months and Days](https://www.ageason.com/experience-calculator/): Calculate your exact work experience between joining and leaving dates. Add multiple jobs or employments to find your cumulative total service.
- [Hitung Hari dan Kalkulator Tanggal: Selisih Hari dan Hari Kerja](https://www.ageason.com/id/hitung-hari/): Hitung hari antara dua tanggal, berapa hari lagi menuju tanggal tertentu, jumlah hari kerja, atau tambah dan kurangi hari dari sebuah tanggal.
- [Kalender Hijriyah Hari Ini dan Konversi Tanggal Hijriah Masehi](https://www.ageason.com/id/kalender-hijriyah/): Kalender hijriyah: lihat tanggal hijriyah hari ini, konversi tanggal masehi ke hijriyah dan sebaliknya, serta daftar 12 bulan hijriyah.
- [日数計算: 2つの日付間の日数と何日後・何日前の計算](https://www.ageason.com/ja/days/): 2つの日付の間の日数、週数、営業日を正確に計算。指定した日数の何日後や何日前の日付も瞬時に計算できます。登録不要・無料。
- [西暦和暦変換と早見表: 令和・平成・昭和・大正と数え年](https://www.ageason.com/ja/era/): 西暦と和暦（令和・平成・昭和・大正・明治）の相互変換と早見表。生年月日から満年齢と数え年、干支、厄年を一覧表示します。
- [年齢早見表 2026年（令和8年）版｜年齢計算・干支・和暦](https://www.ageason.com/ja/): 2026年（令和8年）の年齢早見表。生まれ年ごとの満年齢・和暦（令和・平成・昭和）・干支が一覧でわかります。生年月日から満年齢と数え年も計算できます。
- [날짜 계산기: 디데이 계산과 두 날짜 사이 일수 및 기념일](https://www.ageason.com/ko/date/): 날짜 계산기: 두 날짜 사이 일수와 평일 수, 100일 200일 1000일 기념일 디데이를 계산하고 날짜에 일수를 더하거나 빼 보세요.
- [Calculadora de Dias e Datas: Contagem de Dias e Dias Úteis](https://www.ageason.com/pt/calculadora-de-dias/): Calculadora de dias: conte os dias entre duas datas, os dias úteis, faça a contagem regressiva até uma data ou some e subtraia dias de uma data.
- [Tarih ve Gün Hesaplama: İki Tarih Arası Gün Hesaplayıcı](https://www.ageason.com/tr/tarih-hesaplama/): İki tarih arasındaki gün sayısını hesaplayın veya bir tarihe gün ekleyip çıkarın. İş günleri ve hafta sonları dahil tam döküm.
- [Hicri Takvim ve Tarih Dönüştürücü: Hicri Miladi Çevirme](https://www.ageason.com/tr/hicri-takvim/): Bugünün hicri tarihini öğrenin ve miladi tarihleri hicriye dönüştürün. Diyanet ve Ümmü’l Kura uyumlu hicri takvim.
- [Business Days Calculator: Working Days Between Dates](https://www.ageason.com/business-days-calculator/): Calculate working days between two dates, or add business days to a start date. Excludes weekends with configurable working hours.
- [Age Difference Calculator: Years, Months and Days Between Two People](https://www.ageason.com/age-difference/): Find the exact age difference between two people in years, months and days. Enter two dates of birth to see who is older and by how much.
- [جدول الأعمار بالهجري والميلادي 1448 هـ / 2026 م | كم عمرك حسب سنة الميلاد](https://www.ageason.com/ar/ages/): جدول الأعمار بالهجري والميلادي لعام 1448 هـ (2026 م). اعرف عمر مواليد أي سنة هجرية أو ميلادية (مثل مواليد 1420 هـ أو 1995 م) قبل عيد الميلاد وبعده.
- [كم باقي على العيد: العداد التنازلي لعيد الفطر وعيد الأضحى](https://www.ageason.com/ar/eid/): اعرف كم باقي على عيد الفطر المبارك وعيد الأضحى لعام 1448 هـ بالعداد التنازلي المباشر.
- [تحويل التاريخ من هجري إلى ميلادي والعكس | تقويم أم القرى](https://www.ageason.com/ar/hijri-converter/): تحويل التاريخ من هجري إلى ميلادي والعكس وفق تقويم أم القرى. اعرف التاريخ الهجري اليوم والميلادي اليوم، وحوّل تاريخ الميلاد بين التقويمين.
- [Cat Age Calculator: Cat Years to Human Years](https://www.ageason.com/cat-age-calculator/): Calculate your cat’s age in human years accurately using veterinary life stage guidelines. Free, instant and private in your browser.
- [Chronological Age Calculator: Years;Months;Days for Testing](https://www.ageason.com/chronological-age-calculator/): Find chronological age in years;months;days (e.g. 8;5;19) from birth date and test date, with the 30-day method and adjusted age for prematurity.
- [Dog Age Calculator: Dog Years to Human Years by Breed Size](https://www.ageason.com/dog-age-calculator/): Calculate your dog’s age in human years by weight and breed size using modern veterinary guidelines. Free, instant and private.
- [Agniveer Age Limit 2026-27 Calculator: Army and Air Force](https://www.ageason.com/age-limit/agniveer/): Agniveer age limit by date of birth: Army Agniveer 2026-27 (17½ to 22, born 1 July 2005 to 1 July 2009) and Air Force Agniveervayu intakes 01/2027 and 02/2027.
- [CDS Age Limit 2026-27 Calculator: IMA, INA, AFA and OTA](https://www.ageason.com/age-limit/cds/): CDS age limit by academy: IMA and INA 19 to 24, AFA 20 to 24 (26 with a CPL), OTA 19 to 25. Check your date of birth for CDS (I) 2027 and see the CDS (II) 2026 dates.
- [NDA Age Calculator (2026-2027): Age Limit & DOB Eligibility Check](https://www.ageason.com/age-limit/nda/): Free NDA age calculator by date of birth (DOB). Check your age limit eligibility for UPSC NDA (I) & (II) 2026-2027 exams for male and female candidates instantly.
- [SSC Age Limit 2026-27 Calculator: GD and CGL with Relaxation](https://www.ageason.com/age-limit/ssc/): SSC GD age limit 18 to 23 on 1 January and SSC CGL post groups 18 to 27, 18 to 30, 18 to 32 and 20 to 30 on 1 August. Check your eligibility with OBC, SC/ST and PwBD relaxation.
- [UPSC Age Limit 2026-27 Calculator: Category Relaxation and Attempts](https://www.ageason.com/age-limit/upsc/): UPSC Civil Services age limit: 21 to under 32 on 1 August, plus 3 years for OBC, 5 for SC/ST and 10 for PwBD. Check your eligibility and exam years by date of birth.
- [Generation Calculator: What Generation Am I by Birth Year](https://www.ageason.com/generation-calculator/): Find your generation name, age range and birth years. Detailed breakdown for Gen Alpha, Gen Z, Millennials, Gen X, Boomers and the Silent Generation.
- [Nepali Date Converter: BS to AD and AD to BS](https://www.ageason.com/nepali-date-converter/): Convert Nepali (Bikram Sambat) dates to English (AD) dates and back, with the weekday. See today's Nepali date. Covers 2000 to 2090 BS.
- [Nepali Age Calculator: Age in BS and AD (Bikram Sambat)](https://www.ageason.com/nepali-age-calculator/): Calculate your exact age in Bikram Sambat (BS) and AD. Enter a BS or AD date of birth to convert it and see your age in years, months and days.
- [حساب فرق العمر بين شخصين بالهجري والميلادي](https://www.ageason.com/ar/age-difference/): احسب فرق العمر بين شخصين بالسنوات والأشهر والأيام بالتقويم الميلادي والهجري. أدخل تاريخَي الميلاد لتعرف من الأكبر وبكم.
- [学年早見表 2026年度（令和8年度）｜生年月日から学年・入学卒業年](https://www.ageason.com/ja/gakunen/): 2026年度（令和8年度）の学年早見表。年少から大学4年生まで、学年ごとの生年月日の範囲がわかります。生年月日を入れると今の学年と小学校・中学校・高校・大学の入学・卒業年を計算します。
